lyrics:
[Intro: muted trumpet hook, congas, soft kick]

[Verse 1: light male tenor, off-beat guitar]
She packs the bag before I'm even up
Two towels, cold water, my book, her cup
I burn like paper, she knows that well
She's got the bottle open before I can tell

[Pre-Chorus: bass enters, handclaps]
Turn around, she says. Hold still.

[Chorus: full groove, trumpet answers each line]

Hands on my shoulders, got me covered up

Back of my neck, and then a kiss
Nobody looks out for me like this
SPF love

[Drop: trumpet melody and marimba, no vocal]

[Verse 2: tenor, groove a little fuller]

The backs of her knees, she can't reach there
Twenty years in, it's my favorite chore
I take it slow, then I do some more

[Pre-Chorus: bass and handclaps]
Turn around, I say. Hold still.

[Chorus: full groove, trumpet answers each line]
That's SPF love
Hands on my shoulders, got me covered up
Every inch she knows I'd miss
Back of my neck, and then a kiss
Nobody looks out for me like this
SPF love

[Bridge: beat thins out, voice close]
Reapply every two hours
That's the rule, and it's ours

[Final Chorus: full groove, trumpet on top]
That's SPF love
Hands on my shoulders, got me covered up
Every inch she knows I'd miss
Back of my neck, and then a kiss
Nobody looks out for me like this
SPF love
